question: Who officially opened the Summer Olympics Games 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Emperor Naruhito.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Emperor Naruhito:-**

 
 
• **Emperor Naruhito of Japan officially opened the 2020 Summer Olympics Games on July 23, 2021, at the Olympic Stadium in Tokyo. **
 
• He was the third Japanese Emperor to open an Olympics, following his grandfather Emperor Hirohito (1964 Summer and 1972 Winter Olympics) and his father Emperor Akihito (1998 Winter Olympics).
 
• He was also the honorary patron of Tokyo 2020 Olympic and Paralympics.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vladimir Putin:-**

 
 
• It is a Russian intelligence officer and politician who served as president (1999–2008, 2012– till now) of Russia and also was the country’s prime minister (1999, 2008–12).
 
 
 
• **Xi Jinping:- **
 
 
• **He is a Chinese politician who has been serving as the general secretary of the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) and chairman of the Central Military Commission (CMC), and thus as the paramount leader of China, since 2012. **
 
• Xi has also served as the president of the People's Republic of China (PRC) since 2013.
 
• He belongs to the fifth generation of Chinese leadership.
 
 
 
• **Michel Temer:-**
 
 
• **He is a Brazilian politician, lawyer, and writer who served as the 37th president of Brazil from 31 August 2016 to 31 December 2018. **
 
• He took office after the impeachment and removal from office of his predecessor Dilma Rousseff.
 
• He had been the 24th vice president of Brazil since 2011 and acting president since 12 May 2016, when Rousseff's powers and duties were suspended pending an impeachment trial.
